data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series G AI & Software company seeking valuation assessment against a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company (Palantir). The target's last post-money valuation stands at $8.3B on $530M total raised.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical for Series G-to-next-stage advancement, implying $10.4B. Peer-median analysis examines 12 same-sector companies at similar valuation tiers, including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Scale AI ($29.0B, Series B), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F), and Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C). The peer set ranges from $2.0B to $39.0B; the median across all 12 peers is $9.3B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $7.9B to $11.9B, with a midpoint of $9.8B. This range sits modestly above the current $8.3B post-money but below the most optimistic peer comparables. Key uncertainties include the significant dispersion within the peer set—particularly the outsized valuations of early-stage competitors like Figure and Scale—and the limited visibility into revenue, growth rates, or unit economics across the comp universe. The stage-progression method assumes standard venture step-ups; actual outcomes will depend on demonstrated progress toward Series H milestones.
